messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - multiple 500s in inference runtime during rollout. Affected: hosted API region eu-west-1. Alert group: deploy-errors. Link: https://redwood.inc/incident/2620000000

alice: ack, I see the spike on the dashboard. errors look like decrypt failures in logs. grabbing logs now.

jamal_oncall: I'm oncall, taking lead. tagging releases. can anyone confirm recent config changes in the canary?

sophie_releases: Rolling canary for inference-service went out 14:03 UTC. Canary image: rwinf:v2.4.7. New envs: REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN changed to a rotated key ARN as part of key rotation. No other changes. I did the rollout.

alice: logs: 
```
ERROR: failed to initialize key material: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/inference-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-rotated
```
stack shows failure during model key decrypt -> 502 for many requests.

ben_security: that looks like key policy / grants issue. New key likely doesn't include inference-role principal or grant not created. Did rotation update key policy?

sophie_releases: rotation was automated by key-rotator job earlier today. It created the new key and updated infra templates, but I didn't verify the key policy changes propagated to the cluster IAM role. I assumed rotation service created a grant.

jamal_oncall: impact estimate? cs_lead, do we have a list of customers affected?

cs_lead: initial telemetry shows ~18% error rate for text generation endpoints in eu-west-1, short spikes of 5–15s lat and many 502/500. Some premium customers reported failures. I'll compile list and notify impacted accounts.

alice: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback to previous deployment that uses old key ARN; 2) patch role/key policy to add kms:Decrypt; 3) apply a feature-flag kill-switch so new code path that attempts decrypt isn't used. Rollback fastest if we can do a clean rollback.

jamal_oncall: Sophie, can you do a rollback to rwinf:v2.4.6 for canary and pause rollout? If rollback target will use old key ARN, that should immediately stop decrypt calls to new key.

sophie_releases: initiating rollback now. 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=124
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-service
```
rolling back canary and halting rollout.

ops-bot: deploy: rollback started by sophie_releases at 2026-03-15T14:18:04Z.

alice: confirm logs now show decrypt calls to old key ARN and 5xx rate dropping?

jamal_oncall: monitoring dashboards... error rate falling. within 90s majority of hosts back to healthy. still seeing a small tail of errors from old canary pods terminating.

cs_lead: customer impact window estimated 13 minutes, about 12 unique customers hit errors, 3 support tickets opened. Notified CS.

ben_security: we'll still need to fix root cause. If rotation automation didn't add a proper key policy or grant, we need to patch rotation process. I can push a temporary grant to the new key to restore service without rollback, but since rollback succeeded we're safe and we should treat as postmortem.

sophie_releases: rollback complete, can confirm rollout halted. I'll revert automated rotation pipeline to not rotate keys during active rollouts.

jamal_oncall: good. For next steps: 1) postmortem, 2) verify rotation job creates explicit key policy entries or grants for inference-role, 3) add pre-deploy check to fail if KMS ARN in env isn't accessible by service account, 4) add feature flag to short-circuit decrypt fallback.

alice: adding runbook updates and a preflight script idea: `aws kms test-decrypt --ciphertext <sample> --key-id $REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN --profile prod` (pseudocode) included in release CI.

ben_security: I'll create a minimal IAM grant now for the rotated key so rotation can be retried safely for staging. Command (aws cli):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-rotated --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/inference-role --operations Decrypt --name deploy-rotator-grant
```
I'll file an internal sec ticket to enforce key policy templates.

sophie_releases: filing release ticket to add the preflight check and to make rotation pipeline wait for a successful decrypt check against a canary instance before flipping ARNs in prod.

jamal_oncall: severity final: SEV2 (partial customer impact, rollback restored service quickly). Timeline and ownership:
- 14:03 UTC: canary rollout starts with rotated KMS ARN
- 14:05 UTC: incident-bot triggered on 5xx spike
- 14:06–14:12 UTC: triage and investigation (jamal, alice, sophie)
- 14:13 UTC: decision to rollback
- 14:18 UTC: rollback completed, error rate back to baseline by 14:21
- Impact window ~18 minutes, 12 customers affected, 3 support tickets

jamal_oncall: I'll own the initial postmortem draft and assign follow-ups: ben_security for key policy, sophie_releases for rotation pipeline updates, alice for runbook/preflight script, cs_lead for customer comms. Marking this incident as resolved for now.

ops-bot: incident-resolved: 2620000000 by jamal_oncall at 2026-03-15T14:25:30Z

alice: noted. will attach logs and correlation IDs to the postmortem.

cs_lead: sending initial impact note to the affected customers now.

ben_security: quick note: add an automated check in key-rotation CI that validates both key policy and grants for service principals. We should also add a metric for KMS AccessDenied counts to alert before error rates spike.

sophie_releases: thanks team. will update release runbook and block rotations during high-traffic windows.

jamal_oncall: handing off to next oncall for follow-through. closing thread for paging.
